C0601.title: 13 Sentenced in Yunnan 'Paofen' Money Laundering Ring That Received Over 2.13 Million Yuan from Upstream Scammers
C0601.summary: Between August and December 2023, Yang and Li organized a group including Zeng in Nanhua County, Yunnan, to operate a 'paofen' money laundering scheme. They connected with upstream telecom fraudsters and used personal and third-party bank cards and WeChat accounts to receive illicit funds, then transferred the money through online banking, ATM withdrawals, and cryptocurrency conversion to designat

references.title: Over 2.13 Million Yuan in Criminal Funds Received for 'Upline': 13 Sentenced in 'Running Points' Money Laundering Case
